summary: Wrote a 60-second YouTube launch script for Momentum based on the T2 messaging framework. The script follows the required 5-part structure: Hook (3s, problem-first with streak shame), What is Momentum (10s, energy-adaptive concept demo), How it Works (20s, 3-step walkthrough covering all three differentiators), Why it Adapts (15s, pattern insights with specific data), and CTA (12s, subscribe + link in bio). Includes [ON CAMERA] / [VOICEOVER] labels, on-screen text cues, approximate timings, production notes, and a T2 messaging compliance checklist. Tone is energetic, relatable, and confident throughout.
